lore.bio: Kai took Sombrero-I with fewer losses than the plan allowed for and has been quietly resented for it ever since. She fires first only when the shot ends the argument.

lore.service: Federation Corps of Engineers / Forward Works Detachment
lore.bio: Holt builds the position before he argues about it. Three of his forward depots are still standing on worlds the Federation formally abandoned.
Vale reads a battlefield an hour before it happens and is usually right about the part nobody wanted to hear. Her recon doctrine is now standard across the Group.
Federation-trained, resigned his commission, took a third of his division with him. Treats every engagement as an examination he is setting for someone.

lore.service: Red Ascendancy / Marshal of the Crimson Advance
lore.bio: Korr keeps a battle line moving at a tempo that breaks formations no single push could. Her Wardens do not retreat and are not ordered to.
Dravik fortifies ground the Ascendancy has no doctrinal interest in holding, and is never asked to explain why once the counterattack arrives.
Renn sells terrain telemetry to both sides of the same engagement and has never once been accused of inaccuracy. Adapt, profit, survive; she never said to whom.
Calder appears in after-action reports as an equipment anomaly. Two Coalition auditors have tried to establish whether they are one person.

lore.service: Syndicate Coalition / Directorate of Autonomous Systems
lore.bio: Voss runs the engagement two seconds ahead of everyone standing in it, and considers the delay between his order and its execution a defect to be engineered out.
